widgets_values:
Vision-language captioning with OpenCV 5's native VLM support - no Python ML framework:

  'CV VLM Generate'      decoder-only VLM of the PaliGemma shape: a vision encoder turns the image into feature tokens, the prompt is embedded, and the language model continues [image features | text embeddings]. Here paligemma2-3b-pt-224 (SigLIP + embedding + Gemma2-3B) with the task prompt 'cap en'. NOTE: this export has no KV-cache, so every token re-runs the whole 3B fp32 prefix - a caption takes minutes on CPU.

The node takes a model FOLDER, not a file: models/llm/opencv/paligemma2-3b-pt-224/, whose siglip / embedding / gemma parts are found inside it - one dropdown instead of four, and the advanced '*_file' overrides are all left on 'auto'. Every path is relative to the model root, so this workflow is portable.

As of time of writing (01/08/2026) NOT EVERY MODEL RUNS (e.g. failed to run Florence-2)
